historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot Turbo Vision narrow navigation rows: reserve the source gray bar for wrapped labels.
historical_adaptations.rationale: At 320px, the first wrapped JP row sits 20px above the source gray navigation bar and its black text becomes unreadable on the navy masthead. Reserve two rows of the source gray bar below the unchanged pixel logo. Native visible text ranges fit both rows; 390px/tablet/desktop typography, source colors and positioning remain unchanged.

historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot turbo-vision heading correction: keep wrapped pixel-font headings from striking through at mobile widths.
historical_adaptations.rationale: The pixel typeface (JFDot MPlus 12 via the candidate JP font stack) has a natural line height about 1.09 times its font size, while h1 and the page title carry line-height 0.85em and h2 inherits the fixed 22px body line height at a 24px size; wrapped headings therefore strike through at 768px and below (defect Q1-22). The same-target delta receipt shows line overlap of 7.8px (page title), 7.2px (h1) and 4px (h2) without the correction and zero overlap with line-height 1.15 scoped to max-width:768px, with desktop geometry unchanged and no collateral beyond uniform downstream flow. All six certified blocks are re-certified against the resulting candidate in the same change.
